2609.04329.title: Data-Driven Learning of Unknown Nonlinear Differential Equations Using Functional Analysis
2609.04329.paper_summary: In this paper, the problem of data-driven discovery of nonlinear ordinary differential equations (ODEs) is recast, and a new interpretable machine learning (ML) method is proposed. The proposed method aims to learn the unknown vector field of nonlinear dynamics without prior knowledge of the system's physics from only one single state trajectory's data. The proposed method has two fundamental differences with existing methods: 1) the formulation presented in this method is derived based on Functional Analysis and Operator Theory, and 2) the cost function is constructed in the function space as a distance between two functions as an integral, instead of the discrete-sum of errors used in existing ML approaches. An incremental learning algorithm is proposed to learn the unknown vector field to handle new training samples in an online manner. The proposed method can discover the unknown vector field from both forced and unforced autonomous and non-autonomous (or time-varying) dynamical systems. The proposed method is able to simultaneously discover unknown external forces as a function of time and unknown underlying dynamics. Finally, numerical examples are given to demonstrate the advantages of the proposed method.
2609.04329.paper_summary_zh: 在本文中，數據驅動的非線性常微分方程（ODEs）發現問題被重新表述，並提出了一種新的可解釋機器學習（ML）方法。所提出的方法旨在從單一狀態軌跡數據中學習非線性動力學的未知向量場，而不需要對系統物理的先驗知識。所提出的方法與現有方法有兩個根本區別：1）本方法中提出的公式是基於函數分析和算子理論推導的，2）成本函數是在函數空間中構建的，作為兩個函數之間的距離，表達為積分，而不是現有機器學習方法中使用的離散誤差總和。提出了一種增量學習算法來學習未知向量場，以便以在線方式處理新的訓練樣本。所提出的方法可以從強迫和非強迫的自主及非自主（或隨時間變化的）動力系統中發現未知向量場。該方法能夠同時發現未知外力作為時間的函數以及未知的潛在動力學。最後，給出了數值示例以展示所提出方法的優勢。
